Fairchild Aircraft.fact: In 1929, Sherman Fairchild purchased a majority stock interest in Kreider-Reisner Aircraft Company of Hagerstown, Maryland. The company moved to Hagerstown in 1931.

Fairchild Aircraft.subject: International Relations
Fairchild Aircraft.question: The first C-_____ made its initial flight in November 1947, and by the time production ceased in 1955, more than 1,100 C-119s had been built for use in the USAF, the Royal Canadian Air Force and other
Fairchild Aircraft.fact: The C-119 could carry cargo, personnel, stretcher patients and mechanized equipment with the ability to make "paradrops" of cargo and troops. The first C-119 made its initial flight in November 1947, and by the time production ceased in 1955, more than 1,100 C-119s had been built for use in the USAF, the Royal Canadian Air Force and others.

Fairchild Aircraft.subject: International Relations
Fairchild Aircraft.question: In 1956, the company acquired rights to the Fokker Friendship, producing 206 of the aircraft as the Fairchild F-27 and _____ FH-227
Fairchild Aircraft.fact: In 1956, the company acquired rights to the Fokker Friendship, producing 206 of the aircraft as the Fairchild F-27 and Fairchild Hiller FH-227. In 1964, the company purchased Hiller Aircraft, changing its name to Fairchild Hiller and producing the FH-1100, until 1973 when the helicopter division was sold back to Stanley Hiller.

Fairchild Aircraft.subject: International Relations
Fairchild Aircraft.question: After the company took over _____'s civil assets in 1996, the company was renamed Fairchild Dornier
Fairchild Aircraft.fact: After the company took over Dornier's civil assets in 1996, the company was renamed Fairchild Dornier. The company commenced production of the Dornier 328 in 1998 under license from Deutsche Aerospace AG (DASA).

Fairchild Aircraft.fact: After the company took over Dornier's civil assets in 1996, the company was renamed Fairchild Dornier. The company commenced production of the Dornier 328 in 1998 under license from Deutsche Aerospace AG (DASA).

Fairchild Aircraft.subject: International Relations
Fairchild Aircraft.question: In 2003, the assets of Fairchild were purchased by M7 _____ and the new company was moved to San Antonio
Fairchild Aircraft.fact: The company commenced production of the Dornier 328 in 1998 under license from Deutsche Aerospace AG (DASA). In December 1999, Fairchild Aerospace Corporation was acquired by German insurer Allianz A.G.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: The _____ was American armed fixed-wing counter-insurgency and utility transport aircraft.
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: The Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker is an American armed fixed-wing counter-insurgency and utility transport aircraft developed from the Pilatus PC-6 Porter for the United States Air Force.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: A total of 35 were built under license in the United States by _____, for use during the Vietnam War in the early 1970s
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: A total of 35 were built under license in the United States by Fairchild Industries, for use during the Vietnam War in the early 1970s.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: Thirty-four aircraft were later sold to the _____
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: Thirty-four aircraft were later sold to the Royal Thai Air Force.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: The program, named _____, was designed to add mobility and firepower to the South Vietnamese Republic of Vietnam Air Force (RVNAF) in a relatively short time
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: The program, named Credible Chase, was designed to add mobility and firepower to the South Vietnamese Republic of Vietnam Air Force (RVNAF) in a relatively short time.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: Two commercial aircraft were selected for testing: the _____ and the Helio Stallion
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: Two commercial aircraft were selected for testing: the Fairchild Porter and the Helio Stallion.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: Initial performance testing was conducted with leased aircraft at _____, Florida, and was successful enough to warrant a combat evaluation
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: Initial performance testing was conducted with leased aircraft at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, and was successful enough to warrant a combat evaluation.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: The 20mm cannon was essentially a three-barrel version of the M61 _____ 6-barrel 20mm cannon
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: The 20mm cannon was essentially a three-barrel version of the M61 Vulcan 6-barrel 20mm cannon.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: USAF crews flew 73 missions (94 sorties) and _____ crews flew 68 missions (85 sorties)
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: USAF crews flew 73 missions (94 sorties) and RVNAF crews flew 68 missions (85 sorties).

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: Several problems were discovered during the _____ COIN program, the most serious was the extreme vulnerability of the aircraft to all but the lightest antiaircraft fire (below 12.7mm)
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: Several problems were discovered during the PAVE COIN program, the most serious was the extreme vulnerability of the aircraft to all but the lightest antiaircraft fire (below 12.7mm).

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: Despite the problems, the _____ continued with the development program and ordered 15 AU-23As for further testing
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: Despite the problems, the USAF continued with the development program and ordered 15 AU-23As for further testing.

Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.subject: International Relations
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.question: The 4400th _____ (Provisional) was created to complete the operational test and evaluation of the Credible Chase aircraft
Fairchild AU-23 Peacemaker.fact: The 4400th Special Operations Squadron (Provisional) was created to complete the operational test and evaluation of the Credible Chase aircraft.
